The '''''Justifier''-class''' was a class of [[assault transport]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards]]. The [[starship]] was heavily armed with four [[laser cannon]]s mounted on the edge of its two wings, a powerful [[hyperdrive]] and<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> two<ref name="Bounty Lost" /> [[engine]]s with a reorienting central thruster that folded flat against the sides of the ship to decrease its size during landings. The [[cockpit]] featured several large [[viewport]]s that provided a wide field of view for pursuing targets. The [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] used a ''Justifier''-class transport named the ''[[Justifier]]''<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> during the early [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Bounty Lost" />
